notes.title: New Achievements & Localization Update!
notes.content:

We're thrilled to roll out a fresh update featuring six brand-new achievements for those who crave a real challenge. Whether you're taking down bosses, mastering hard mode, or dropping a nuke — your feats now come with the glory they deserve.

🆕 New Achievements:

Reach the Boss

notes.title: 🚨 Big Update: Relics Overhaul, Survival Mode Expansion, and some Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey Scavengers,

We just dropped a big update packed with improvements, fixes, and all-new content to take your run to the next level. Here's what’s new:
[hr][/hr]🔧 Bug Fixes
Fixed flyer laser sight getting stuck

Fixed double-click bug when placing the first gadget

Fixed movement audio getting stuck

Fixed issue where you couldn’t pick up a beacon near other drills

Fixed dynamite cost not updating properly
[hr][/hr]🎥 Quality of Life
Added smooth animations when gaining / spending resources

Cleaner camera transitions during gameplay
[hr][/hr]💀 Survival Mode Expanded
Extended Survival Mode with 8 brutal new waves

More chaos, more enemies, more reasons to upgrade or die
[hr][/hr]🧬 Relic System Overhaul
The whole relic flow just got a juicy makeover:

Choose from 3 relics every time

Reroll relics with Oil or Scrap if you don’t like your luck

Added 11 new relics — and most of them stacks

Time to start crafting some wild builds
[hr][/hr]🧱 New Relics Include:
💧 One-Time Oil Drop

🧱 One-Time Iron Drop

🛠 One-Time Scrap Drop

🔫 Faster Fire Rate

🛡 Armor Boost

🚛 Faster Truck

⛏ Skip Drilling

🐛 Driller Movement Speed

🛠 Faster Player Driller

🚀 Rocket Launcher (New Weapon!)

☢️ Nuke (New Weapon – be careful!)
[hr][/hr]
Stack ‘em up, fire away, and drill deeper than ever.
This wasteland’s not gonna conquer itself.

Stay oiled,
— The Dead Oil Dev Team

notes.title: 🛠 Steam Fest Demo Update And Player Feedback!
notes.content:
Gameplay & Balance
[olist]
New Upgrade – Add an upgrade to lower the main pipe, reducing backtracking in later stages.

Shorter Run – Demo length reduced by 2 waves for a more focused experience.
[/olist]
Drilling & Driving Improvements
3. Snappier Transitions – Faster and more responsive switching between driving and digging.
4. Improved Driller Look – Updated visuals for the driller body.
5. Smoother Hole Entry – Easier to enter drilling zones.


Combat & Clarity
6. Helicopter Telegraphing – Now fires a red laser before attacking.
7. Dozer Attack Marker – Clearer visual cue when the dozer’s plow is ready to strike.
8. Artillery Indicator – Increased size for better visibility.
9. Turret Movement Indicator – New visuals for lifting/lowering the turret.


Collection & Responsiveness
10. Scrapper Radius Increased – Easier to collect enemy parts with a bigger collection zone.
